description: Look up a Linea transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use linea_receipt, for emitted events linea_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x638169f15ccab7f5491b46b3a883fa1aa5b5399ba5c56fa0110355d47a526a93. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: linea_tx
title: Linea transaction
